name: Soul Flower

prices.note: Whole catalog via /products.json (439 products, pages 1–2). Only 2 dresses, both regular price: Thyme to Wander Smocked Dress $44 and Magic Mandala Dress in Blues $50. The 'Hippie Dresses & Boho Skirts' collection feed returned 13 items, mostly skirts, rompers and overalls.

sale_pattern: Closeouts and last-chance items at 60–85% off
notes: Homepage title 'Hippie Clothing & Boho Gifts | Soul Flower'; meta: 'organic cotton tees and patchwork pants to flowy skirts, hippie stickers, and boho headbands'.

About page: 'Since 1999, we've created cool threads for kind heads'; footer 'Independent & woman-owned since 1999'; address 204 12th St #103, Des Moines, IA 50309; 'Organic cotton, hemp, and recycled fibers make up a lot of what we do.' Footer badges read 'GOTS Certified Organic Textiles' and 'Fair Trade Certified' (badges only, no detail; not stored as certifications).

Catalog by product_type (439): stickers 85, magnets 40, patches 29, earrings 26, t-shirts 25, headbands 24, pants 16 (+5 under 'Hippie Clothing > Pants'), dresses 2. Pants $38–$88 at regular price, e.g. Classic Patchwork Pants $38, Long Story Short Harem Pants $40, Easy Breezy Patchwork Wide Leg Pants $72.

Shipping: ships from Des Moines IA; shipping-info page says 'Free US shipping on orders over $150' (a footer also offers free US shipping on a first order over $50). International rates at checkout; countries not named, so only US stored.
Returns: within 45 days of receipt, unwashed and unworn; customer pays return shipping ($7.95 deducted for its label service); no exchanges; final sale not returnable.
Sizes from product variants: SM, MD, LG, XL on most clothing, XXL on 53, 2X on 3; navigation has a Plus Size section (has_plus). Size guide is image-only.
